_comment: Arena v3 promotion — WINNER + GAME_LINES, PRE-GAME + IN-PLAY. Forward-only select (out-of-sample pre-game edge only). 4 agents = top-2 per category x $100/agent. daily_cap_dollars is SHARED across both categories AND pre/in-play (the hard real-spend limit). max_open=10 leaves room for in-play after pre-game. A real order fires ONLY when master.armed=true AND live_promote_v3.py --execute AND master.kill=false. Set master.kill=true to flatten the real book + halt.
